import numpy as np

def cloud(obs, cam):

+"""DexToolBench long screwdriver controller utilities and episode record.
+
+The live episode was controlled through the Robot client, with each short motion
+chosen after checking the calibrated camera views and joint positions. The
+service trajectory is the authoritative record. This file keeps the visual
+measurements and action helpers used during the episode in one place.
+"""
+

+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = ("front", "side", "top", "oblique")
+
+
+def world_cloud(obs, camera: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Unproject a calibrated depth image to world coordinates."""
+    depth = obs.depth[camera][0].astype(np.float64)
+    calib = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(calib["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
+    T = np.asarray(calib["cam2world_gl"], dtype=np.float64)
+    row, col = np.indices(depth.shape)
+    cam = np.stack(
+        ((col - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0],
+         -(row - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1],
+         -depth),
+        axis=-1,
+    )
+    return cam @ T[:3, :3].T + T[:3, 3]
+
+
+def save_views(obs, name: str) -> None:
+    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{name}_{camera}.png")
+
+
+def robot_positions(obs) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:29], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def send_target(robot: Robot, target: np.ndarray, seconds: float, name: str):
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", target, dt=seconds, cameras=CAMERAS,
+        include_depth=True, video="none", note=name,
+    )
+    save_views(result, name)
+    print(name, "joints", np.round(robot_positions(result)[:7], 3),
+          "goals", result.meta["task"]["goals_reached"], flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def hand_cloud(obs, camera: str = "top") -> np.ndarray:
+    """Visible blue-white hand surface near the table."""
+    xyz = world_cloud(obs, camera)
+    rgb = obs.last[camera]
+    mask = (
+        (xyz[:, :, 0] > -0.3) & (xyz[:, :, 0] < 0.3)
+        & (xyz[:, :, 1] > -0.2) & (xyz[:, :, 1] < 0.5)
+        & (xyz[:, :, 2] > 0.53) & (xyz[:, :, 2] < 0.9)
+        & (rgb[:, :, 0] > 100)
+        & (rgb[:, :, 2].astype(np.int16) > rgb[:, :, 0].astype(np.int16) + 5)
+    )
+    return xyz[mask]
+
+
+def gray_tool_cloud(obs, camera: str = "top", on_floor: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Candidate screwdriver pixels; inspect views before acting on them.
+
+    Table shadows and arm links share the screwdriver's gray color, so the
+    returned points are candidates rather than a trusted pose estimate.
+    """
+    xyz = world_cloud(obs, camera)
+    rgb = obs.last[camera].astype(np.int16)
+    neutral = (rgb.max(axis=2) - rgb.min(axis=2) < 16)
+    height = ((xyz[:, :, 2] > 0.005) & (xyz[:, :, 2] < 0.08)) if on_floor else (

+        & (xyz[:, :, 1] > -0.2) & (xyz[:, :, 1] < 0.6)
+    )
+    return xyz[mask]
+
+
+def main() -> None:

+        hand = hand_cloud(obs, camera)

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
